integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite exhaustive tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite assertions. Structural decompositions and idempotent-function counts from previous literature are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is for the specified direct sum of two-dimensional nilpotent evolution algebras, not arbitrary evolution algebras.
Counting is for labeled finite-field-linear endomorphisms.
The discrete-Gaussian approximation is for fixed field cardinality; its center varies with the algebra dimension.
Literature comparisons do not prove publication priority; independent mathematical assessment has not been performed.
title: Retraction ranks of a two-step nilpotent evolution algebra: exact census and logarithmic Gaussian drift
